title: Dog Day Care
excerpt: Supervised, social days out in our secure location so your dog comes home happy and tired, not bored and lonely.
intro: A proper day out for your dog. Our secure, purpose-built daycare facility means supervised, social days in a safe and stimulating environment — with access to our private woodland for enriching walks and exploration. Small, carefully matched groups, constant supervision and vet-nurse oversight, so health and happiness come first every single day.
highlights: Free collection & drop-off in our local areas
Photo updates so you never miss a moment
Free trial day to see if it's the right fit
